## Evidence

<!--
TARHAN's acceptance bar (see README "The honesty model"): a numeric claim is
pinned to a printed source value, a measured convergence order, an exact
structural invariant, or a measurement recorded in the code. A tolerance invented
to make a test pass is not acceptable.

Paste the relevant test output, or say why no numeric claim is involved.
-->

- [ ] `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] Any new numeric threshold is pinned to a source, a measured order, or a
      recorded measurement — and the basis is written next to it in the code
- [ ] If a physics formula is added or changed, it carries an honesty tier and a
      source citation
